headline: Four Nifty 500 stocks finish below VWAP
hook: Technical weakness signals potential selling pressure
summary: On October 8, four Nifty 500 stocks closed more than 2% below their volume-weighted average price (VWAP). This technical indicator suggests that the stocks ended the session at a price lower than the average price at which they were traded throughout the day. KPR Mill is among the companies identified in this technical scan. This data highlights stocks experiencing downward price momentum relative to their daily trading volume.
why_it_matters: Stocks trading below VWAP may face continued short-term selling pressure.
